video.title: AI欧腐《死对头Alpha不知道我怀了他的崽/My Alpha Rival Doesn't Know I'm Carrying His Baby》
video.desc:
idrama难得有个完结的
Noah Reed, a brilliant Omega PhD candidate in artificial intelligence, has spent his entire life competing with Damian Black, a powerful Alpha and tech billionaire. To everyone else, they are lifelong rivals. What no one knows is that Noah has secretly loved Damian for years. Three months ago, during a manipulated rut, Damian spent one unforgettable night with an Omega whose identity he never discovered. That Omega was Noah. Now Noah is pregnant with Damian’s child—and determined to keep it a secret. After overhearing Damian vow to hunt down everyone involved in that night, and learning that Damian has loved someone else for eight years, Noah becomes convinced there is no place for him or his baby in Damian’s life. But a mysterious Secret Room repeatedly traps the two rivals together. To escape, they must reveal secrets the other does not know. With every confession, old grudges turn into proof of hidden devotion: Damian secretly protected Noah when he was abandoned at seventeen, followed his life from afar for eight years, and remembers every Alpha who ever came close to him. When Damian finally proposes—believing Noah is carrying another Alpha’s child—the truth becomes impossible to hide. The baby is his. And the person Damian has loved for eight years has always been Noah.

Noah Reed，一位天资过人的 Omega，人工智能博士生，这辈子都在与强大的 Alpha、科技业亿万富翁 Damian Black 较劲。在外人眼里，他们是一生的宿敌。可谁也不知道，Noah 早已暗恋 Damian 多年。
三个月前，在一场被人操控的易感期中，Damian 与一个始终不知身份的 Omega 共度了难忘的一夜。那个 Omega，就是 Noah。
如今 Noah 怀上了 Damian 的孩子——并决心守住这个秘密。他无意中听到 Damian 发誓要揪出那晚所有相关的人，又得知 Damian 已经爱了另一个人整整八年，于是认定，Damian 的生命里不会有他和孩子的位置。
然而，一间神秘的"密室"却一次次把这对宿敌关在一起。想要脱身，就必须说出对方不知道的秘密。随着一次次坦白，昔日的恩怨渐渐变成了深藏的情意的证据：Damian 在 Noah 十七岁被抛弃时曾暗中护他周全，八年来一直远远关注着他的人生，甚至记得每一个曾经靠近过他的 Alpha。
当 Damian 终于求婚——以为 Noah 怀的是别的 Alpha 的孩子——真相再也无法隐藏。
孩子是他的，而 Damian 爱了八年的那个人，从来都是 Noah。
